title: 2 Chinese arrested over alleged illegal copper ore transport in Cebu

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Two Chinese nationals were arrested after authorities intercepted two trucks carrying about 47 tons of unprocessed copper ore allegedly transported using falsified permits at Pier 4 in Cebu City on Wednesday, Oct. 28. The Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) said the operation resulted in the seizure of approximately 47,040 kilograms of copper ore valued at P1.5 million. The suspects, identified only as “Kui,” 55, of Tagum City, Davao del Norte, and “Sheng,” 45, of Makati City, were apprehended while aboard separate 10-wheeler wing vans carrying the mineral ores, the CIDG said in a statement.
